name: Ostellato (Italy)
description: Light blue field with a white central panel charged with the crowned municipal arms of Ostellato (stars on blue above a wheat sheaf on red) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Ostellato, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Ostellato arms — stars on blue above a wheat sheaf on red, crowned, within branches
